basic_info.description: The Sky House, designed by renowned San Francisco architect Jeff Buris, is arguably one of the most dramatic modern homes in the city, with impeccable finishes and panoramic views of the bay.  Rarely does a home so deftly balance unique modern details with natural materials that give an overall feeling of style and comfort. The adaptable floor plan suits a variety of lifestyles.  The entry-level has a multi-purpose room with a full kitchen. The seamless indoor/outdoor flow is ideal for hosting an event or enjoying the outdoors. The main living area encompasses a great room with a living room, dining area and kitchen. The kitchen has state-of-the-art appliances, a breakfast peninsula and an adjoining deck. There are also three large en-suite bedrooms.  The primary suite will leave you breathless with unparalleled views of the bay through a floor-to-ceiling glass wall that opens up to a deck. It has a luxurious bathroom with dual vanities and a soaking tub. The roof deck is another showstopper with a grill and full kitchen, stylish custom sauna spa and views from the Golden Gate Bridge to the Bay Bridge.  1110 Green will leave a lasting impression for its luxurious comfort and its practicality.
